name: Math
overview: Scripture reveals that God uses precise numbers to accomplish His purposes, as seen in the detailed measurements of Noah's ark (Genesis 6:15) and the specific pairs of animals preserved within it (Genesis 6:19). The Bible also teaches the importance of numbering our days wisely to gain understanding (Psalms 90:12) and highlights God's intimate knowledge of us, even counting the hairs on our heads (Matthew 10:30). Furthermore, Christ expands the concept of numbers beyond human limits by instructing forgiveness to be extended seventy times seven times (Matthew 18:22), illustrating that divine principles transcend mere arithmetic.
